watches.name: 1904 Chrono, Steel / Off White
watches.description: The 1904 Chronograph is our first watch with a non-round case. Shaped with defined angles, softened edges and a proportion that draws inspiration from early Art Deco design. It's a silhouette built on clarity, symmetry, and clean transitions. The dial is layered, with cutouts for subdials and a distinct outer groove that frames the layout. Each edition features its own dial finish, but all share the same focus on visual balance. This is also the first watch in our collection with a fully integrated bracelet and FKM rubber strap. Both developed from scratch to match the case. Tapering from 24mm to 16mm, they connect without lugs, following the curvature of the case for a seamless fit. A faceted crystal tops the case and mirrors its geometric lines. The subdials include a 24-hour indicator, along with chronograph functions for running seconds and a 30-minute counter. The result is a watch that looks unlike anything we’ve made. Lighter than expected, and made to wear like it was built for your wrist. Because it was.

watches.name: 1970 Haagen GMT Automatic, Steel / Green  - Swiss Made
watches.description: 1970 GMT Automatic was developed in collaboration with renowned watch specialist, Kristian Haagen. As a true feinschmecker, he has an uncompromising eye for quality and along with a lifelong passion for wristwatches, spotting and reviewing quality timepieces has become his livelihood. 1970 GMT Automatic is the result of a careful design process, where only the best could do. A Swiss automatic movement, a sophisticated green-gold bezel and a GMT function gives you a timepiece, unapologetic of its brilliance. First created for pilots flying across time zones in a matter of hours, the GMT function kept track of both the local time and the time in the place from where they departed. No longer exclusive to the first great travellers of the world, the 1970 GMT Automatic is the perfect companion as you embark on your next adventurous travels.

watches.name: 1815 Justin Gatlin, Steel / Blue Turtle
watches.description: Our collaboration with American sprinter Justin Gatlin features two new editions of our bestselling 1815 Chronograph. Inspired by his long-lasting career and astonishing track record, we created a timepiece with thought behind every little detail. Choose between a Steel / Blue Turtle or Gold / Blue Turtle. Justin Gatlin wanted a timepiece, fit for the track yet wearable for any evening event. The combination of a classic and timeless frame offered by 1815 Chronograph along with the edgy nature of our Nato straps, brought to life the vision presented by Justin Gatlin. It’s the best of both worlds. To become one of the world’s best sprinters, dedication is a demand on the road to success. 1815 Justin Gatlin edition is your chance to keep excellence close at all times… Because time always matters.
